text: Deepfakes of real people take minutes to make. The harm lasts much longer.
Meet Forged Media Detection. Spot fake and intimate images, then act before the legal deadline.
Check any image. Two independent models score forgery and explicit content, then the rulebook routes it.
Uncertain cases go to a person. The queue is sorted by legal deadline, with India at two hours.
Every decision is sealed. Reports verify as valid. And the image itself is never stored.
